latin: Per hanc dictionem <Hebrew>, quae scribitur per Aleph, Iod, et Scin, et significat Virum, quae deo attribuitur cum dicitur Vir belli, de trinitatis mysterio per uiam Cabalae perfectissime admonemur.
latin_note: The sheet's bracketed run '<WN>' renders as OCR garble the Hebrew word spelled out immediately after it, Aleph, Yod, Shin, following Farmer's transcription (farmer1998:27117); replaced here with '<Hebrew>'. translation: By this word, spelled with alef, yod and shin, meaning 'man' — a word applied to God when he is called a man of war — we are most fully instructed, by way of the Cabala, in the mystery of the Trinity.
translation_note: 'man of war' echoes Exod. 15:3; Farmer's note takes each of the three letters as standing for one Person of the Trinity, as with shin and Christ in 11>14 (farmer1998:27151).
